# Summary

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Summary`](gmeow-Summary.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Summary>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/provenance`](../../slices/provenance.md)

A condensed account derived from a source information object (often machine-generated), linked to its source by [`gmeow:wasDerivedFrom`](../properties/gmeow-wasDerivedFrom.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Summary`](gmeow-Summary.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
